requirement: PRD sections 8-10 and supplied repository AGENTS private security reporting
coverageBoundary: Existing intake owns durable private receipt and authorization intent. Case decisions remain in cases.md. Backend screening, routing, and forwarding completion fences lack an executable successor.
missingTransitions: Link an already committed submission, report bytes digest and immutable report version to the screening request. Take a running claim under revision CAS and increment the revision.
Allow expired-running, queued and unavailable retry. A stale screen result cannot mutate current version or schedule analysis or write routing notices.
Same-project exact duplicate holds privately before any model call. A validated overlap becomes needs-information. Coarse reporter-facing language cannot leak older report identity or summaries.
An authorized current security maintainer may record a version-checked private forward or request-information override. Preserve per-report routing once and the private notice authority at commit.

A held or information-requested report may append new private bytes under a revision check while preserving the original report and case receipt. A replacement clears only the current screening/routing projection.

Forwarding send, listing reconciliation and exact receipt retrieval each require the same unexpired submission/session/reporter grant. A failed or uncertain forward preserves the report and its private review. Existing intake boils receipt verification and no-send evidence down to booleans.
policyBoundary: The pinned PRD section 8 explicitly specifies Surplus-only private screening and forbids report execution. Section 5 broader fallback wording also names private-report analysis. Exact pinned application has fixed Surplus-only screening. Preserve that route pending authoritative policy clarification if a distinction is needed.

entries.anchor: Automatic screening owns one report version
